chitchat: Pell shoulders a coil of rope and grunts a greeting.
"Tide's turning. You can smell it, if you've got the nose."
"Don't go past the Slip after dark. That's all I'll say."
description: A wiry stevedore who has hauled the same quays for twenty years and has opinions about all of them. Rope-scarred hands, a roll-up welded to his lip.

root.text: Pell drops his end of a crate and wipes his hands. "You lost, or just in the way?"

clothing_layers: a hi-vis vest gone the colour of nothing

name: Pell
